name: E3 engine boundary and library provenance
description: Opens an isolated software fixture project and imports a fixture open-source library (SETUP, through the same IPC the Library browser uses; licence and source recorded). Then, with real X input: the Library panel search lists the imported part with its source; disabling that library in Libraries hides it from the search and enabling it shows it again (F8: the enabled flag is honoured); the part's details say placing copies it into the project; Place on schematic plus a click on the canvas places it, and the status bar reports the single Batch that copied the definition into the project library (F8: placing from an imported scope succeeds). The KiCad licence gate (F2) needs a native file dialog and is covered by unit tests; sourcing writes (F1) have no window of their own and are covered by tests and the CI engine-boundary scan.

steps.title: E3: open the Library tab of the bottom dock (Phase 1 A3)
E3: the Manage mode of the Library dock (D1) holds the part editor and the library switches
